# Hiking Authority

> > The authoritative reference for understanding hiking as outdoor recreation, covering 57.8M annual US participants across trails, regulations, and wilderness management.

Hiking Authority provides comprehensive guides and reference materials on hiking mechanics, trail systems, federal regulations, and long-distance trail planning. The site aggregates information on 200,000+ miles of US trails across national parks, national forests, and wilderness areas, with detailed planning guides for major thru-hiking routes including the Appalachian Trail, Pacific Crest Trail, and Continental Divide Trail.

## Key Topics

- Appalachian Trail
- Pacific Crest Trail
- Continental Divide Trail
- National Park Service
- U.S. Forest Service
- Bureau of Land Management
- Wilderness Act of 1964
- Thru-hiking
- Long-distance hiking
- Backcountry hiking
- Trail difficulty ratings
- Wilderness permits
- Trail management
- Hiking safety
- National Trails System

## Foundational Guides

- [Hiking: What It Is and Why It Matters](https://hikingauthority.com): Homepage defining hiking as outdoor recreation with 57.8M annual US participants
- [How It Works](https://hikingauthority.com/how-it-works.html): Guide explaining hiking mechanics, trail difficulty, safety, and planning fundamentals
- [Key Dimensions and Scopes of Hiking](https://hikingauthority.com/key-dimensions-and-scopes-of-hiking.html): Reference on federal land systems, permits, and regulatory framework for hiking

## Long-Distance & Thru-Hiking Trails

- [Appalachian Trail: Routes, Sections, and Planning](https://hikingauthority.com/appalachian-trail-overview.html): Planning guide for 2,198-mile Appalachian Trail from Georgia to Maine
- [Pacific Crest Trail: Routes, Sections, and Planning](https://hikingauthority.com/pacific-crest-trail-overview.html): Planning guide for 2,653-mile Pacific Crest Trail from Mexico to Canada
- [Continental Divide Trail: Routes, Sections, and Planning](https://hikingauthority.com/continental-divide-trail-overview.html): Planning guide for 3,100-mile Continental Divide Trail across western US
- [Long-Distance Hiking Trails: Thru-Hikes and Multi-Day Routes](https://hikingauthority.com/long-distance-hiking-trails.html): Guide to thru-hikes, triple-crown trails, and multi-week hiking logistics
- [Iconic Long-Distance Hiking Trails in the US](https://hikingauthority.com/iconic-us-long-distance-trails.html): Overview of major US long-distance trails and National Trails System framework
- [Thru-Hiking: Long-Distance Trail Journeys](https://hikingauthority.com/thru-hiking.html): Guide to thru-hiking triple-crown trails and long-distance trail mechanics

## Trail Systems & Destinations

- [Best Hiking Trails in the United States](https://hikingauthority.com/best-hiking-trails-in-the-us.html): Guide to 200,000 miles of US trails across national parks and public lands
- [National Park Hiking Trails: A Complete Reference](https://hikingauthority.com/national-park-hiking-trails.html): Complete reference to 21,000 miles of trails across 63 US national parks
- [Hiking in US National Forests](https://hikingauthority.com/national-forest-hiking.html): Guide to hiking 193M acres across 44 states via USFS permits and regulations
- [Wilderness Hiking Areas Across the US](https://hikingauthority.com/wilderness-hiking-areas.html): Guide to legally-defined wilderness areas, permits, and backcountry access rules
- [Hiking Trails by Difficulty: Easy, Moderate, and Strenuous](https://hikingauthority.com/hiking-trails-by-difficulty.html): Reference on trail difficulty ratings and assessment factors across agencies

## Hiking Types & Planning

- [Day Hiking: Planning and Preparation](https://hikingauthority.com/day-hiking.html): Planning guide for day hikes covering route selection, gear, and safety prep
- [Overnight Hiking and Multi-Day Trips](https://hikingauthority.com/overnight-hiking.html): Guide to overnight and multi-day trips covering permits, camping, and logistics
- [Wilderness Hiking: Backcountry and Remote Trails](https://hikingauthority.com/wilderness-hiking.html): Guide to backcountry hiking under Wilderness Act regulations and trail navigation
- [How to Get Help for Hiking](https://hikingauthority.com/how-to-get-help-for-hiking.html): Guide to guide services, credentials, wilderness instruction, and safety providers

## Regulations & Reference

- [Recreation Regulations: Statute and Code Reference](https://hikingauthority.com/regulations.html): Dataset of 160+ verified regulatory citations for hiking laws and compliance
